original_card.acceptance_gate: An exact arbitrary-input identity, source/target frame availability and restoration at the chosen cut, plus the complete channel+correction+idle/hosting bill or an explicit favorable bound. The native channel alone is not a supplier. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. actual_scope: On the PR #3954 two-axis scaffold, the literal correction Pi P_enc Pi extended by identity on the 72 helper roles does not match an adjacent call's data charts (T, I) to (F, E), does not advance a helper from the identity entrance to the full-F exit, and leaves the published gate over capacity for every nonnegative slot-exchange price.
scope_change_reason: Open question 1 of research/p104-literal-slot-defect asks whether Pi P_enc Pi matches helper roles as well as both data banks and whether the bill is favorable. This package answers that question on the pinned #3954 entrance, exit and gate. It does not construct a new chronological correction word.
bottleneck_link: The literal-slot identity already supplies an intertwiner on the two data banks. A favorable adjacent pair would still have to match helpers and beat the scaffold capacity. This certificate shows that pair is not the #3954 contract, so the obstruction stays in force and kappa does not move.
stop_rule: Stop after the chart mismatch on every nonzero address of (F_2)^4, the identity helper extension on one witness, and the nonnegative gate. Do not search another gauge, price a native word, or treat the 96-port support of Pi as a tariff.
evidence: PROOF.md derives the chart inequality, the zero helper-boundary progress, and the excess 44096+s. verify.py recomputes those integers and the Gaussian-integer charts, and checks that Pi P_enc Pi plus an identity helper coordinate intertwines the literal encoding while fixing the helper.
